$comment: Stable error codes. `retryable` is the default hint; a result may override it. `user_message` is the default customer-facing copy; UIs may localise.

PROTOCOL_INCOMPATIBLE.user_message: One of your DoMe components needs an update before they can talk to each other.

SIGNATURE_INVALID.user_message: This phone is not authorised for that PC. Try pairing again.

UNKNOWN_KEY.user_message: This phone is not paired with that PC.

CONTROLLER_REVOKED.user_message: Access for this phone was revoked. Pair again from the PC to restore it.

GRANT_MISSING.user_message: This phone does not have permission for that action on this PC.

ACCOUNT_MISMATCH.user_message: That PC belongs to a different account.

TARGET_PC_MISMATCH.user_message: The command was addressed to a different PC.

COMMAND_EXPIRED.user_message: That took too long to reach the PC. Try again.

CLOCK_SKEW.user_message: The PC's clock looks wrong. Check the time settings on the PC.

COMMAND_ID_REUSED.user_message: The request was rejected for safety.

UNKNOWN_ACTION.user_message: That action is not supported by this PC.

INVALID_PARAMETERS.user_message: Those settings are not valid for this action.

CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED.user_message: Confirm this action on your phone.

CONFIRMATION_INVALID.user_message: The confirmation did not match. Start again.

CONFIRMATION_EXPIRED.user_message: The confirmation timed out. Start again.

PC_OFFLINE.user_message: The PC is not connected right now. Nothing was sent.

PC_RECONNECTING.user_message: The PC is reconnecting. Try again in a moment.

PC_REMOTE_DISABLED.user_message: Remote control is switched off on the PC. Turn it on from the DoMe tray icon.

PC_SESSION_LOCKED.user_message: The PC is locked. Unlock it on the PC to continue.

QUEUE_FULL.user_message: The PC is busy with earlier commands. Try again in a moment.

RATE_LIMITED.user_message: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.

TARGET_REQUIRED.user_message: Choose which tab or player to control.

TARGET_AMBIGUOUS.user_message: More than one video is playing. Choose a tab.

TARGET_GONE.user_message: That tab or window is no longer there.

TARGET_CHANGED.user_message: The page changed before the action ran. Nothing was done.

EXTENSION_DISCONNECTED.user_message: DoMe's browser extension is not connected on the PC. Open Chrome or Edge and check the extension.

EXTENSION_NOT_INSTALLED.user_message: Install the DoMe browser extension on the PC to control YouTube.

BROWSER_NOT_RUNNING.user_message: The browser is not open on the PC.

NO_NEXT_VIDEO.user_message: There is no next video available.

NO_PREVIOUS_VIDEO.user_message: There is no previous video available.

UNSUPPORTED_CONTEXT.user_message: This control is not available for the current page (for example an ad, a live stream, or Shorts).

ACTIVATION_REQUIRED.user_message: Fullscreen must be started on the PC itself; the browser blocks remote fullscreen.

ACTION_UNAVAILABLE.user_message: That control is not available right now.

APP_NOT_APPROVED.user_message: That app is not approved for remote control. Approve it on the PC first.

APP_LAUNCH_FAILED.user_message: The app could not be started.

FOCUS_DENIED.user_message: The app was started but Windows did not allow it to come to the front.

CLOSE_REFUSED.user_message: The app did not close. It may be asking about unsaved work on the PC.

MEDIA_SESSION_GONE.user_message: That media player is no longer available.

OUTCOME_UNKNOWN.user_message: The PC lost connection while running this. It may or may not have happened. Check the PC's current state before retrying.

PLATFORM_UNSUPPORTED.user_message: This action is only available on Windows.

ENTITLEMENT_REQUIRED.user_message: This is a DoMe Pro feature.

DEVICE_LIMIT_REACHED.user_message: Your plan's device limit has been reached.

PAIRING_CODE_INVALID.user_message: That pairing code is not valid or has expired. Get a new code from the PC.

PAIRING_DECLINED.user_message: Pairing was declined on the PC.

INTERNAL.user_message: Something went wrong on our side. Try again.

CONTROLLER_MISMATCH.user_message: This phone's identity did not match the request. Pair again if this keeps happening.

TAB_NOT_CONTROLLABLE.user_message: Reload the YouTube tab on the PC so DoMe can control it.

PC_SESSION_LOCKED_MEDIA_ONLY.user_message: The PC is locked. Only media controls are allowed until it is unlocked.

PC_PLAN_DISABLED.user_message: This PC is not enabled on your current plan. Choose it in Devices or upgrade to DoMe Pro.

CONTROLLER_PLAN_DISABLED.user_message: This phone is not enabled on your current plan. Choose it in Devices or upgrade to DoMe Pro.

ENTITLEMENT_PENDING.user_message: Your payment is being confirmed. Pro features unlock automatically once it is verified.

BILLING_PAST_DUE.user_message: Your last payment did not go through. Update your payment method to keep DoMe Pro.
